scripts.check: calcit calcit.cirru --check-only --all-defs && calcit calcit.cirru fix --workflow strict --verify --format json | jq -e '.data.workflow.status == "passed" and .diagnostics == []' && calcit calcit.cirru analyze weak-types --only deprecated-call --summary-only --format json | jq -e '.data.summary.calls == 0' && calcit calcit.cirru analyze quality --baseline config/calcit-quality.cirru
scripts.build: yarn compile && yarn test && vite build
